title: Product Except Self
contract: For every position, multiply all other elements without division. Products fit long; an empty product is 1.
reasoning: The baseline explicitly omits the current position, so zeroes need no special cases.
Store exclusive prefix products in the output itself.
A backward suffix accumulator completes each product. This saves an extra suffix array and handles one or multiple zeroes.
